result.description: Creator-economy commerce platform (FanBasis, rebranded Commas) for checkout, subscriptions, invoices, customers and payments.
result.auth_detail: Public API uses x-api-key header, with per-key scopes and separate production and sandbox keys. Official MCP uses an OAuth login flow. The API's 401 message also mentions a Bearer token.
result.access_detail: Keys are created in the dashboard under Account → API Keys. A separate sandbox dashboard issues sandbox keys. I found no plan or approval gate in the docs. A seller account is needed, and I did not check whether signup or the API is plan-restricted.
result.api_notes: Base URL https://www.fanbasis.com/public-api/. Resources: checkout sessions (including embedded), customers and payment methods/charge, discount codes, invoices, products, subscribers, subscriptions and proration, transactions and refunds, and webhook subscriptions. The docs page references hundreds of method/path mentions. The docs are at commasdocs.com, a JS-rendered page (fbnewapi.netlify.app redirects there). The brand was reportedly renamed from FanBasis to Commas, per a third-party source I did not verify.

evidence.quote: Everything you need to collect payments, manage subscriptions, and automate your business with the Commas API.
Every API request must include your API key in the x-api-key header.
Log into your Commas dashboard and go to Account → API Keys. Copy your API key.
Each environment needs its own API key registered against your account
Complete API reference for the Commas API. Checkout sessions, webhooks, customers, subscriptions, discount codes, and more.
Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok directly to your Commas account via MCP.
